AEESH

Rayuwar Aeesh a gidan su Abba Ta zama Tamakar rayuwar baiwa a Kurkuku Sosai Inna Saude ke nuna Rashin Imaninta akanta Tana Gana Mata Azaba Ta ko ina.

Rufe ta tayi a small room na part ɗin ta ,Dakin Na Dauke da Toilet Sai Gado daya Madaidaici, Akwai Television da Fridge a dakin

A ciki take Gudanar da Komai nata bata fita ko'ina haka babu mai shigowa, Abinci ma idan za'a bata Sai sunci Sun Rage, Sai a Ajiye mata basu Damu ba idan taci Ko Bata ci ba, Wannan ba damuwarsu bane .

So tari sai Abincin yayi kanzo sai a kankaro Mata, Tun tanaci tana Amai har ta fara sabawa, Sun Maidata Mara Yanci, da Sanin Abba Ake zalinta mata, A Gaban Abba Take sawa a kai mata Abincin da suka Rage yana Gani, Saude ta riga Ta Gama dashi Bashida na faɗa,Baffa dama Ya tsaneta Baya Kaunar ta Hakan Da Ake Mata Shine daidai A wajenshi, Su Salem kuma ba wani zaman gidan Sukeyi ba a zatonsu Aeesh ta bar Kasar Tana Chan wajen Ummanta Kaman Yanda Inna Saude ta Gaya msu Tun Farko.

Tsabar Rashin Imanin Abba yana sane da Komai ya kasa Kama Gaskiya ya kawar dakai Akan Barazanar Saude ya ceci ɗiyar Ƴar uwarsa.


Sai a yanzu ta Gasgata batun Ammi da tace Batada Kowa a duniyar nan bayan Ita, Duk kaunar da Ashman kenuna mata da zarar mummunar ƙaddara ta sameta Kyaleta Zaiyi ,Ammi itace gatan ta Itace Gatanta a duniyar nan bata da Kowa bayan ita.


AEESH kullum Cikin Gudanar da Salloli take tana Kai Kukanta ga Allah domin Kuwa tasan shine Majiyin rokon bayi kuma zai yaye mata komai, Akoda yaushe Cikin addu'a take Allah Ya ba Ammi ta lafiya Ya dawo mata da ita Lafiya, Idan Ka ganta yanzu sai ta baka Tausayi, Ta ƙanjame taRame sosai Duk Jikin ta ƙasussuwa Ne Tako Ina Bata da kuzari Kullum Cikin Rashin lafiya Take Amma Babu wanda ya sani, dunkunewa Take tasha Kukanta har bacci Barawo ya sace ta.

SHAYE-SHAYE: Shine Cusawa Gangar jiki duk wani abu da zai sa mutum Maye ko ya fita daga Hayyacin, Tunanin dama hankalin sa na dogo ko gajere lokaci sannan daga bisani ya dawo Hayyaci sa (normal state). Wannan Matsalar bata yau bace ba kuma ta jiya bace domin an kwashe shekaru Da dama ana yi.

ta lalata rayuwar mutane haka ta kai wasu da dama har zuwa ga sun rasa rayukansu Kaman Yanda Ta Raba wasu Da Hankulansu Gabaki daya.

Domin ko akasarin masu aikata ta'addanci daga nan suke farawa kuma bincike ya tabbatar da cewa suna amfani da kayan SHAYE-SHAYE kafin suyi dukan wani mummunan aiki da sukeyi.

Ranar suna Yara sukaci Sunan ZEEYK da Bintou, daɗi wajen Maryam kam ba'a magana, gani take kaman Sureey ta gama mata Komai Tunda ta haifa mata takwarar Mahaifiyar ta da yayanta wanda yafi kowa sonta a duniya, tayi bajinta wajen bude Bakin Aljihunta ga maman baby yara kam Sun ga gata ta ko ina, Saleem ma ba'a barsa a baya ba, ganin Irin Ɗokin Da Maryam Keyi yasa shima ya bada nasa Gudummuwarsa Sosai ya faranta mata rai kuma hakan yayi masa daɗi sosai, Shikou Duk abinda zaiyi wanda zai sakata Farinciki shi yake yi, Aeesh Kam Sune Uwar Baby Sune gaba Gaba a taron, lokacin Noor na da 9months ta fara zuwa ko ina da kafarta, Ayyan kam an girma, har yanzu yana wajen su Abba, Salem bai daukoshi ba a Ganinshi zai takura masa ne.

Bayan Arba'in Aka daura auren Sureey da Rabeel (Ashraf) akan Sadaki Dubu hamsin Lakadan ba ajlan ba, a ranar da ta kasance rana mafi Farinciki a Rayuwar Rabeel,kuma ranar da ta kasance mafi tarihi a Rayuwarta bata taɓa tunanin Sake rayuwa da wani namiji ba bayan ZEEYK Allah kenan, wanda ka shirya rayuwarka da tashi daban Wanda Allah ya tsara zaka kare rayuwarka dashi daban.


Shekara daya kenan Da rasuwar ZEEYK Amma har yanzu yana Nan Manne a Zuciyarta, bazata taɓa mantawa dashi ba, ya zamo kaman katanga da ta kare Zuciyarta daga ganin Kowa sai dai a yanzu Rabeel yana neman ya Ture wannan Katangar ya gina nasa soyayyar a cikin Zuciyarta.

Bayan sati biyu aka ɗaura auren Ammie da Ajmal, da kuma nafeesah ƴar inna saude da Ayman (babban Ɗan Ajmal Angon Ammie), sannan Rihaan Shima da Zee a satin da ya biyo baya kuma akayi na barr Abdool da Hafsah Kanwar Aashman, auren da yabawa kowa mamaki duba da yanda basua jituwa ada, Amma cikin kankanin lokaci Kiyayyar da suke ma juna ya juye zuwa soyayya mai Tsanani, ada yaso ya auri barr Bintou Saboda tun a Law school yake ƙaunarta amma taƙi bashi dama akan Nata dalilin, hakan yasa ya haƙura ya nemi soyayya a wajen Hafsah Kuma ta amince gashi Har sunyi aure.

Ana gama Biki Sadeeq Ya dau Amaryarsa Reey suka koma Canada inda yake aiki, bazasu dawo ba sai nan da shekaru uku.


Daddy Ajmal da Abba suka  tara Ashman Da saleem Ganin Har yanzu akwai wani yar tsama a tsakanin su, saleem yaki ya yafewa Ashman Kazafin da yayi masa, Ashman Kuma yaki saukar dakai ya bada haƙuri .
